title: Gardenio E2E: Create, Prove, Fix
description: Master formula for gardenio's own e2e test ecosystem using a gardenio-e2e namespace as testbed. Three modes: author (create new test modules), fixer (fix flaky modules), claudeless (expand session simulation scenarios).

vars.name: MODE
vars.description: Sub-workflow to run: author (new module), fixer (fix flaky module), claudeless (session scenario)

vars.name: TARGET
vars.description: Module or feature name (e.g. webhook-retry, slack-cards, formula-pour-lifecycle)

vars.name: BRANCH
vars.description: Git branch to work on (e.g. agent/e2e/add-webhook-retry)

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: Analyze and plan test scenarios (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 1: Analyze

Analyze the target and plan what to test.

### If MODE=author (new module)

1. Read code paths for {{TARGET}} in gardenio/controller/, kbeads/, or coop/
2. Identify kd/gb commands and API endpoints involved
3. List testable scenarios: happy path, error cases, edge cases
4. Check existing tests for overlap: `grep -r '{{TARGET}}' gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/`
5. Read gardenio/tests/e2e/README.md for conventions

### If MODE=fixer (fix flaky module)

1. Check recent e2e.yml runs for test-{{TARGET}}.sh pass/fail history
2. Run the module 3x locally to reproduce the failure:
   ```bash
   cd gardenio && NAMESPACE=gardenio-e2e ./tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh
   ```
3. Classify: deterministic failure, timing flake, env flake, CI-only
4. Read the test script to understand what it tests

### If MODE=claudeless (session scenario)

1. Map the {{TARGET}} workflow: user prompts, tool calls, hook invocations
2. Read existing scenarios: gardenio/tests/e2e/claudeless/*.toml
3. Identify session config, response sequences, tool mocks
4. Check if claudeless binary is available: `which claudeless`

### Deliverables

Post a comment on this bead with:
- Mode: {{MODE}}
- Target: {{TARGET}}
- Scenario list (author) / failure classification (fixer) / workflow map (claudeless)
- Code references (file:line)
- Dependencies and prerequisites

Then close this step.

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: Write test / establish baseline (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 2: Write or Baseline

### If MODE=author — Write the test module

Create `gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh` following the standard pattern:

```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
# test-{{TARGET}}.sh — {{TARGET}} E2E tests
set -euo pipefail

NAMESPACE="${NAMESPACE:-gardenio-e2e}"
BEADS_SVC="${BEADS_SVC:-${NAMESPACE}-beads}"
KD_BIN="${KD_BIN:-kd}"
GB_BIN="${GB_BIN:-gb}"
PASS=0; FAIL=0; ERRORS=()
PF_PID=""; CREATED_BEADS=()
export KD_ACTOR="${KD_ACTOR:-e2e-test}"

# Standard helpers: red/green/blue/dim, pass/fail, assert_exit, assert_contains
# Standard setup: setup_portforward, setup_token, cleanup trap
# Scenarios: blue "Scenario N: ..." + assertions
# Summary: pass/fail count, error list, exit code
```

Conventions:
- Use unique test tags: `TEST_TAG="e2e-{{TARGET}}-$$-$(date +%s)"`
- Clean up ALL created beads in the trap
- Each scenario is self-contained (creates its own test data)
- Use `$KD_BIN` and `$GB_BIN` for commands, never hardcode paths
- Test both success AND error paths

Commit the test script.

### If MODE=fixer — Pre-fix baseline (20 runs)

Run `test-{{TARGET}}.sh` 20x against gardenio-e2e:

```bash
PASSES=0; FAILS=0; TOTAL=20
for i in $(seq 1 $TOTAL); do
  echo "=== PRE-FIX BASELINE Run $i/$TOTAL ==="
  NAMESPACE=gardenio-e2e bash gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/baseline-$i.txt
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then PASSES=$((PASSES+1)); else FAILS=$((FAILS+1)); fi
done
echo "PRE-FIX: $PASSES/$TOTAL passed, $FAILS/$TOTAL failed"
```

**FLAKINESS GATE**: If 20/20 pass, STOP — module is not flaky. Close all remaining steps.

Post baseline as comment.

### If MODE=claudeless — Write TOML scenario

Create `gardenio/tests/e2e/claudeless/{{TARGET}}.toml`:

```toml
[claude]
session_id = "e2e-{{TARGET}}-0001"
username = "e2e-test"
permission_mode = "accept-edits"
trusted = true
logged_in = true

[claude.timeouts]
hook_timeout_ms = 10000

[[responses]]
on = { contains = "trigger phrase" }
say = "Agent response text"
[[responses.tools]]
call = "Bash"
[responses.tools.input]
command = "kd create 'test' --type task"
[responses.tools.result]
stdout = "Created: gd-test-001"
exit_code = 0

[default]
say = "I'm an E2E test agent."

[tools]
mode = "live"
[tools.Bash]
approve = true
```

Commit the scenario.

### Deliverables
- author: committed test-{{TARGET}}.sh
- fixer: baseline posted (X/20 pass) or STOP if 20/20
- claudeless: committed {{TARGET}}.toml

Close this step.

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: Run, diagnose, fix (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 3: Run and Fix

### If MODE=author — Run against gardenio-e2e

1. Run the new module 5x:
   ```bash
   for i in $(seq 1 5); do
     NAMESPACE=gardenio-e2e bash gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/author-run-$i.txt
   done
   ```
2. Fix any failures found during runs
3. Iterate until 5/5 pass consistently
4. Post pass evidence as comment

### If MODE=fixer — Diagnose and fix

**EMPIRICAL EVIDENCE RULE**: Every fix MUST target a specifically observed failure from the baseline.

Prohibited fixes (unless baseline demonstrates the exact failure):
- Adding generic waits or sleeps
- Changing selectors that aren't failing
- Refactoring test structure when structure isn't causing failures

Diagnosis categories:
- (A) Test bug — fix the test
- (B) Gardenio code bug — file bug bead, close remaining steps with BLOCKED
- (C) Infra/env issue — file bug bead, close remaining steps with BLOCKED
- (D) Test rewrite needed — rewrite targeting observed failures

Apply fix and commit.

### If MODE=claudeless — Run scenario

1. Run with claudeless:
   ```bash
   claudeless run gardenio/tests/e2e/claudeless/{{TARGET}}.toml --settings .claude/settings.json
   ```
2. Verify hooks fire correctly
3. Fix scenario issues and re-run
4. Post pass evidence

### Deliverables
- author: 5/5 pass evidence
- fixer: committed fix with root cause explanation
- claudeless: passing run evidence

Close this step.

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: Stability proof (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 4: Stability Proof

### If MODE=author — 20-run stability proof

```bash
PASSES=0; FAILS=0; TOTAL=20
for i in $(seq 1 $TOTAL); do
  echo "=== STABILITY Run $i/$TOTAL ==="
  NAMESPACE=gardenio-e2e bash gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh 2>&1 | tee /tmp/stability-$i.txt
  if [ $? -eq 0 ]; then PASSES=$((PASSES+1)); else FAILS=$((FAILS+1)); fi
done
echo "STABILITY: $PASSES/$TOTAL passed, $FAILS/$TOTAL failed"
```

Must achieve 20/20. If not, go back to step 3.

### If MODE=fixer — Post-fix stability (20 runs)

Same 20-run loop as author mode.

Post complete flakiness proof:
```
## Flakiness Proof
Pre-fix: X/20 passed (Y% failure rate)
Post-fix: 20/20 passed (0% failure rate)
Delta: Y% → 0%
```

If < 19/20: iterate back to step 3.

### If MODE=claudeless — 10-run stability

Claudeless scenarios are deterministic, so 10 runs suffices:
```bash
for i in $(seq 1 10); do
  claudeless run gardenio/tests/e2e/claudeless/{{TARGET}}.toml --settings .claude/settings.json
done
```

All 10 must pass.

### Deliverables
- author: 20/20 stability proof
- fixer: complete flakiness proof (pre + post)
- claudeless: 10/10 proof

Close this step.

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: Wire into the E2E pipeline (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 5: Wire Into Pipeline

### If MODE=author — Add to run-shard.sh

1. Add the `should_run` + `run_module` block to `gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/run-shard.sh`:
   ```bash
   if should_run "{{TARGET}}"; then
     run_module "{{TARGET}}" "./gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/test-{{TARGET}}.sh" || MODULE_RC=1
   fi
   ```
   Place it in alphabetical order among the existing modules.

2. Add JUnit XML entry:
   ```xml
   <testcase name="{{TARGET}}" classname="gardenio.e2e" />
   ```

3. Update `gardenio/tests/e2e/README.md` with:
   - Module name and description
   - Scenarios covered
   - Prerequisites

4. Commit all changes.

### If MODE=fixer — No pipeline changes needed

The module is already in the pipeline. Just commit the fix.

### If MODE=claudeless — Wire scenario into runner

Option A: Add to existing test-gate-system.sh as a sub-scenario
Option B: Create a new test-claudeless.sh module that runs all TOML scenarios

If Option B:
```bash
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
for toml in gardenio/tests/e2e/claudeless/*.toml; do
  name=$(basename "$toml" .toml)
  echo "Running claudeless scenario: $name"
  claudeless run "$toml" --settings .claude/settings.json || { echo "FAILED: $name"; exit 1; }
  echo "PASSED: $name"
done
```

Then add to run-shard.sh like the author mode.

### Deliverables
- Pipeline updated (author/claudeless) or confirmed no changes needed (fixer)
- README updated if applicable

Close this step.

steps.title: {{TARGET}}: PR with evidence (mode={{MODE}})
steps.description:
## Step 6: PR and Cleanup

1. Push branch:
   ```bash
   git push -u origin {{BRANCH}}
   ```

2. Create PR:
   - Title: depends on mode:
     - author: `test(gardenio/e2e): add {{TARGET}} test module`
     - fixer: `fix(gardenio/e2e): fix flaky {{TARGET}} module`
     - claudeless: `test(gardenio/e2e): add {{TARGET}} claudeless scenario`
   - Description includes:
     - What was done
     - Stability proof (20/20 or 10/10)
     - For fixer: full flakiness proof with pre/post comparison
     - Scenarios covered
     - Example output

3. Link MR to bead: `gb mr link <bead-id> <mr-url>`

4. Verify CI passes on the PR

### Deliverables
- PR URL posted as comment
- PR linked to bead
- CI green

Close this step and the parent molecule.
